items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: He said, 'Gertie Saunders has made that same mistake. She left a musical comedy to go into burlesque.'

ctx.x: And the when the "Covered Wagon", I had it fixed with the Indians in there and all that. Well, this was the beginning. Well, Lyons was very pleased with this, you see. So he said to me, "Well, I'll tell you, Fletcher Henderson is making a mistake. He's going from a cabaret back to a dance hall. And you never step backwards." And he's the first one told me, he said, "Gertie Saunders has made that same mistake. She left a musical comedy to go into burlesque. Which is a step beneath." And you never step backwards,…
